necessary_context.content: E1,E2 are finite-dimensional real normed spaces. A:E1→E2*, A*:E2→E1* is defined by <Ax,u>2=<A*u,x>1. The dual norms are ||s||i*=max_{||z||i=1}<s,z>i. Write a=||A||1,2=max_{||x||1=||u||2=1}<Ax,u>2, so ||A*u||1*≤a||u||2.
necessary_context.name: Spaces, pairing and operator norm

necessary_context.content: Q2 is a nonempty closed bounded convex subset of E2; phi_hat is continuous convex on Q2. d2 is continuous and sigma2-strongly convex on Q2, sigma2>0. Normalize d2(u0)=min_Q2 d2=0. For mu>0 define f_mu(x)=max_{u∈Q2}{<Ax,u>2-phi_hat(u)-mu d2(u)} and f0 by omitting mu d2. D2=max_Q2 d2 is finite. The separate f_hat term in (2.2) is not included in this f_mu.
